title: General Optimal Stopping without Time Consistency
summary: In this paper, we propose a new framework for solving a general dynamic optimal stopping problem without time consistency. A sophisticated solution is proposed and is well-defined for any time setting with general flows of objectives. A backward iteration is proposed to find the solution. The iteration works with an additional condition, which holds in interesting cases including the time inconsistency arising from non-exponential discounting. Even if the iteration does not work, the equilibrium solution can still be studied by a forward definition.
